description: This PHP source file defines a class 'NavigationBarTester' within the 'Step\/Acceptance' namespace, which provides methods for interacting with and testing the navigation bar elements in SuiteCRM's web interface, tailored for different device breakpoints.

classes.name: NavigationBarTester
classes.description: A tester class for navigating and interacting with the SuiteCRM navigation bar across different device breakpoints.

methods.name: clickHome
methods.description: Clicks on the home button or navbar brand, depending on device breakpoint.

methods.name: clickUserMenuItem
methods.description: Selects a user menu item from the global links menu, tailored for the current device breakpoint.

methods.name: clickAllMenuItem
methods.description: Navigates to a module by selecting an item from the top-level 'All' menu, considering device-specific navigation structures.

methods.name: clickCurrentMenuItem
methods.description: Selects an item from the current module's dropdown menu, with behavior adjusted for different device breakpoints.
